'''N4-3PO''' was a [[Color/Legends|metallic green]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] owned by [[Tol Pirilian]]. N4-3PO and Pirilian's other droid, [[N3-3PO]], could use over six million forms of communication, and often communicated using obscure [[Language/Legends|languages]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
